fusions.name: Canopy Stoop
fusions.desc: You glide to a target up to 8 tiles away and strike it for 28 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. The hit is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Launch Draught
fusions.desc: You spring off the ground, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hang Time
fusions.desc: You jump 3 tiles from where you stood, and your dodge chance rises by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Hollow Bones
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
